sermon.title: Warning: The King Jesus Conspiracy is Strong and Growing — July 19, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer warns that a conspiracy against King Jesus is strong and growing. Like Absalom’s showmanship that detoured people from David, some lead people from Jesus and claim grace covers everything. The religious leaders conspired and killed Him, and Jerusalem fell as prophesied. Believers need not fear: nothing touches them unless God allows it.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And so it is written, “The first man Adam became a living being.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

faqs.question: How did Absalom make his entrance?
faqs.answer: He provided chariots, horses and 50 men to run before him — a great show.

faqs.question: Can we get through divorce or child rebellion?
faqs.answer: Yes; nothing can happen unless God ordains it, and you have the tree of life.

faqs.question: Did those who rejected Christ pay?
faqs.answer: He says they paid a horrible price.
